question: Can lending a bounded number of workers to the oldest overdue request improve P99 on long streams with little cost to the rest?
default_order: Use incumbent size priority for all normal dispatches. Only the oldest unfinished admitted job can override it when its waiting age exceeds the configured delay and it has ready work and fewer than the configured number of workers serving it. A blocked job never reserves an idle worker. Controls and science are unchanged.

Require those same aggregate conditions on the separate confirmation sample before a single official replay.

Do not choose another candidate from this grid after confirmation or scoring.
